inv.desc_en: 23 m² premises located in Madrid. This is a 23 m² space that houses an electrical transformer station inside. The premises are located in the Vista Alegre neighborhood, in the Carabanchel district, within the urban center of Madrid. It has good access via the A-42, M-30, and M-40 highways. It is well-connected by the Madrid Metro, with the Vista Alegre and Carabanchel stations (Line 5), as well as several urban bus lines that connect to different parts of the city. In the area, we can find services such as supermarkets, restaurants, educational centers, sports facilities, bank branches, and other commercial businesses. It is just a few minutes from the Palacio Vistalegre and the Gómez Ulla Central Defense Hospital, landmarks in the Vista Alegre and Carabanchel area. With our services, you will be able to find the premises you need and secure your investment with the best specialized advice. Start right now by requesting more information. A representative near you will assist you personally.
